name: pawper.dev
description: Phillip A. Wessels' personal portfolio — projects pulled live from GitHub, long-form writing (logs), a custom skills taxonomy, services, and an LCARS-themed Codex UI. Read-only, public, statically generated with Astro.

none.description: Public, read-only portfolio. All content is unauthenticated.

skills.name: Browse projects
skills.description: List or read portfolio projects pulled from GitHub at build time, with language stats and activity history.
examples: Read details for the project at /p/pawper-dev-astro-vc

skills.name: Browse logs
skills.description: Read long-form writing organized by series, kicker categories, and skills.
examples: List logs in the React series

skills.name: Browse skills
skills.description: Query the custom skills taxonomy with distribution charts and per-skill filtering across projects and logs.

skills.name: Browse services
skills.description: List the six service types Phillip offers (employment, contracting, consulting, coaching, speaking, mentoring), with status and endorsements pulled from Airtable.
examples: What services is Phillip currently open to?
Show endorsements for the consulting service

skills.name: Browse about
skills.description: Read the who-is-Phillip-Wessels surface: bio, skills overview, activity, training, and resume.

skills.name: Browse experiences
skills.description: Read past and ongoing experiences (jobs, contracts, talks, mentorships, agenda events) at /xp/{id}/. Categories include employment, contracting, consulting, coaching, speaking, mentoring, education, attending, volunteering.
examples: Get details for the experience at /xp/{id}/

skills.name: Subscribe to RSS feeds
skills.description: Five RSS feed types: all projects, all logs, featured projects, per-category, and activity.
examples: Fetch /feed/activity.xml for the commit heatmap stream

skills.name: Send a contact message
skills.description: POST a JSON message to /.netlify/functions/contact with {name, email, subject?, message, token?}. Server-side reCAPTCHA v3 + honeypot anti-abuse, then forwarded to Netlify Forms.
examples: Send Phillip a message about a consulting opportunity
Reach out about a speaking engagement

skills.name: Endorse an experience
skills.description: Build a prefilled Airtable URL for leaving an endorsement on a specific past or ongoing experience. Pattern: https://airtable.com/app5WObcR6LNZ9bQv/pagfzcuqMVAgL0FKk/form?prefill_Service={category}&prefill_Skills%20List={skills}&prefill_Experience={id}&hide_Experience=true
examples: Generate the endorsement URL for experience id 'role-foo-bar'
Leave an endorsement for a coaching engagement
